source: GameSpot 'Best Settings For Modern Warfare 4' 16.10.2026 (Intelligent movement: Sprint assist Off, Mantle assist Off; Movement behaviors: Tap to slide/Hold to dive, Automatic airborne mantle Off, Slide maintains sprint On; Advanced: Sprint/Tactical sprint behavior Toggle, Auto move forward Off, Auto door peek Off, Grounded mantle Off, Tactical sprint activation Single tap sprint); IGN Best Settings for MW4 (Mantle Assist Off, Tap to Slide, Slide/Dive Activation Delay Short, Automatic Airborne Mantle Off, Slide Maintains Sprint On, Toggle, Auto Move Forward Off, Auto Door Peek Off, Grounded Mantle Off); Dexerto MW4 controller wiki (recommends Sprint Assist On + Grounded Mantle On, otherwise agrees: Mantle Assist Off, Tap to Slide, Airborne Mantle Off, Slide Maintains Sprint On, Toggle, Auto Move Forward Off, Auto Door Peek Off, Single Tap Sprint); Dot Esports controller 23.10. (Sprint Assist Off, Mantle Assist Off, Tap to Slide); ConquestCapped 26.10. (Sprint assist Off: adds a delay and slows your aim after a sprint; Mantle assist Off; Slide maintains sprint On); Playhub 23.10. (Mantle assist off prevents unwanted climbing in gunfights; Slide/Dive Activation Delay Short = less hold time; Single Tap Sprint); Beebom 28.10. (Slide/Dive Activation Delay Short, Toggle, Auto Move Forward Off, Auto Door Peek Off); gameboost (Sprint Assist Off, Mantle Assist Off, Tap to Slide, Slide Maintains Sprint lets you keep sprinting after the slide, Toggle, Auto Move Forward Off, Auto Door Peek Off). Only settings with 3+ agreeing sources; disputed options (Corner Slice, Sprint Restore, Parachute, Combat Roll) left out. | Tac Sprint: MW4 S1 patch notes (Blood Rush perk in MP) via 11.11. settings post + gameboost + ConquestCapped; Warzone S1 patch notes 05.11. (Tac Sprint default, no perk needed). | Menu groups per GameSpot/IGN/allthings.how (Grounded Mantle = Movement Advanced Settings). Tactical Sprint Activation options (official MW4 launch notes 02.11.): double tap / single tap sprint / single tap run (default); 'Single tap sprint' per GameSpot, IGN, Dexerto, Playhub, Dot Esports (others pick run) - same value as our 20.11. Warzone settings post. Sprint Assist is split ~5:5 across guides -> CTA asks it as a debate.

caption:
MW4 movement settings 🏃 The best Modern Warfare 4 movement settings for controller in multiplayer and Warzone: Mantle Assist off, Sprint Assist off, Tap to Slide with a short Slide/Dive Activation Delay, Slide Maintains Sprint on, Sprint/Tactical Sprint Behavior on Toggle and Tactical Sprint Activation on Single Tap Sprint. In multiplayer Tac Sprint needs the Blood Rush perk, in Warzone no perk. Sprint Assist on or off? Comment below 👇 Save this for your next match & send it to your squad!
